headline: Brazil Central Bank Expected to Pause Interest Rate Cuts at 13.75%
summary: Brazil's central bank is expected to pause its interest rate cuts at 13.75% as inflation tops its goal and the real slides.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions in major emerging markets dictate domestic borrowing costs, currency valuations, and fixed-income yields for international investors.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: The central bank's expected interest rate pause sets the benchmark borrowing cost for Brazil.
